// The cases of main.xo through github.com/pelletier/go-toml/v2 v2.4.3's
// Marshal: run in a module that requires it; its output equals main.xo's
// up to the "errors" line.
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/pelletier/go-toml/v2"
)

type Server struct {
	Host string `toml:"host"`
	Port int    `toml:"port"`
	TLS  bool   `toml:"tls"`
}
type Feature struct {
	Name    string `toml:"name"`
	Enabled bool   `toml:"enabled"`
	Weight  int    `toml:"weight"`
}
type Config struct {
	Title    string    `toml:"title"`
	Server   Server    `toml:"server"`
	Features []Feature `toml:"features"`
	Replicas []string  `toml:"replicas"`
}
type Strs struct {
	Plain string `toml:"plain"`
	Quote string `toml:"quote"`
	NL    string `toml:"nl"`
	Tab   string `toml:"tab"`
	DQ    string `toml:"dq"`
	BS    string `toml:"bs"`
	Ctl   string `toml:"ctl"`
	Del   string `toml:"del"`
	Uni   string `toml:"uni"`
	Empty string `toml:"empty"`
}
type Opts struct {
	Some   *int           `toml:"some"`
	None   *int           `toml:"none"`
	Empty  []int          `toml:"empty"`
	Inner  map[string]int `toml:"inner"`
	Nested [][]int        `toml:"nested"`
	Inline [][]Feature    `toml:"inline"`
	Mixed  []Server       `toml:"mixed"`
}
type Floats struct {
	A float64 `toml:"a"`
	B float64 `toml:"b"`
	C float64 `toml:"c"`
	D float64 `toml:"d"`
	E float64 `toml:"e"`
	F float64 `toml:"f"`
	G float64 `toml:"g"`
}
type Leaf struct {
	X int `toml:"x"`
}
type Mid struct {
	C Leaf `toml:"c"`
}
type Top struct {
	B Mid `toml:"b"`
}
type Sub struct {
	K string `toml:"k"`
}
type Item struct {
	N   int `toml:"n"`
	Sub Sub `toml:"sub"`
}
type Deep struct {
	A     Top    `toml:"a"`
	Items []Item `toml:"items"`
	Last  int    `toml:"last"`
}

func show(name string, v any) {
	fmt.Printf("--- %s\n", name)
	b, err := toml.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("error %v\n", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Print(string(b))
}

func main() {
	one := 1
	show("config", Config{Title: "orders", Server: Server{"0.0.0.0", 8080, true},
		Features: []Feature{{"search", true, 10}, {"export", false, 3}}, Replicas: []string{"db-a", "db-b"}})
	show("strings", Strs{"hello", "it's", "a\nb", "a\tb", "say \"hi\"", "C:\\dir", "\x01x", "\x7f", "h\u00e9llo \u2713", ""})
	show("keys", map[string]int{"": 2, "a.b": 1, "ok_key-1": 4, "with space": 3})
	show("opts", Opts{Some: &one, Empty: []int{}, Inner: map[string]int{}, Nested: [][]int{{1, 2}, {3}},
		Inline: [][]Feature{{{"a", true, 1}}}, Mixed: []Server{}})
	show("floats", Floats{0.1, 1e-7, 1e21, -2.5, 123456.789, 1.5e300, 2.5e-10})
	show("deep", Deep{A: Top{Mid{Leaf{1}}}, Items: []Item{{1, Sub{"v"}}, {2, Sub{"w"}}}, Last: 9})
}
